subject: ela
name: English Language Arts
title: Kindergarten English Language Arts: Phonics, Print Concepts & Early Reading
overview: Kindergarten English Language Arts immerses young learners in rich literature, structured phonics routines, vocabulary enrichment, and expressive writing workshops.
competencies: Demonstrate phonemic awareness and mastery of grade-appropriate decoding patterns.
Retell stories with key details, identifying central characters, settings, and sequence of events.
Extract and communicate central ideas from informational texts.
Compose well-structured sentences and narrative/opinion compositions using standard conventions.

modules.title: Phonemic Awareness & Alphabetic Principle
modules.description: Mastering letter names and sounds, blending consonant-vowel-consonant (CVC) words, and recognizing high-frequency sight words.

topics.title: Letter-Sound Correspondences
topics.description: Associating all 26 uppercase and lowercase letters with their primary phonemes.

topics.title: Blending & Segmenting CVC Words
topics.description: Blending onset and rime, isolating initial, medial, and final sounds in words like cat and sun.

topics.title: High-Frequency Sight Words
topics.description: Reading grade-level sight words (the, of, and, you, to) with automaticity.

modules.title: Story Comprehension & Literary Retelling
modules.description: Identifying key details, characters, settings, and main events in narrative literature.

topics.title: Characters, Setting & Major Events
topics.description: Asking and answering who, what, and where questions about stories read aloud.

topics.title: Retelling with Beginning, Middle & End
topics.description: Sequencing story events using temporal signal words (first, next, last).

modules.title: Informational Texts & Early Writing
modules.description: Extracting facts from informational books and composing simple opinion, informative, and narrative sentences.

topics.title: Main Idea & Details in Nonfiction
topics.description: Identifying the main topic and supporting facts with teacher scaffolding.

topics.title: Opinion & Informative Writing Workshop
topics.description: Drawing, dictating, and writing sentences with spacing, capitals, and punctuation.
